name: Problem Solving
overview: Scripture teaches that problem solving begins with trusting in the Lord wholeheartedly rather than relying on our own understanding, as Proverbs instructs us to acknowledge God in all our ways so He can direct our paths. In times of trouble, calling upon God leads to deliverance and brings glory to Him, highlighting the importance of prayer and dependence on His guidance. Jesus encourages persistent seeking through asking, seeking, and knocking, assuring that God responds to those who earnestly pursue Him. Additionally, resolving conflicts biblically, as shown in Matthew 18, fosters reconciliation and unity, demonstrating that godly problem solving involves both divine reliance and practical steps toward restoration.
